records.eligibility_summary: All mentored scholarships require an additional scholarship application, letters of recommendation, an essay, a student-involvement resume and admission to and participation in the University Honors Program. All awards are competitive and not guaranteed. 10 students are awarded for each program every year. Application deadline: Dec. 1 Additional information (row cell): Kentucky and out-of-state students with an interest in undergraduate research.
records.notes: Corrected 2026-10-22 (owner-approved) from the 2026-27 record, re-read against the archived official page (sources/pipeline/KY/2026-10-02-r2/evidence.json, page 788ed8a99248e88c3e07; fetched 2026-10-02, Last-Modified 2026-10-01). The page states the programs are for first-time freshmen entering in Fall 2027 (2027-28). Listed under 'Mentored Scholarships' (table lead: 'Application deadline: Dec. 1'); page: 'Competitive and Mentored Scholarships: Dec. 1 deadline. Additional application and materials required.' This is a competitive opportunity: meeting the printed weighted GPA and SAT/ACT figures makes a student eligible to apply, not an award. Cells copied as printed (the SAT/ACT column prints SAT then ACT; no conversion). The column header is prefixed to the GPA and SAT/ACT cells ('Weighted GPA: ', 'SAT/ACT: '); the cells themselves are as printed. thresholds.gpa_min is not carried over: 3.5 is the minimum to apply for a competitive award, not an award criterion. eligibility_summary joins three passages of the Mentored Scholarships section (the sentence 'View the resume scoring rubric.' between them is left out) and then the row's Additional Information cell, all verbatim. Evidence: sources/pipeline/KY/2026-10-02-r2/evidence.json#5e720306add4303e; owner decision: pipeline/decisions/KY-2026-10-02-r2-louisville-correction.json.
